def forecast_job_market(data, years_ahead=2):
    # Convert data to a pandas DataFrame with datetime index
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)
    df = df.set_index(pd.to_datetime(df['start_date']))

    # Convert all columns to numeric data type, and replace all non-numeric values with NaNs
    for col in df.columns:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

    # Define model
    model = VAR(df)

    # Fit the model
    fitted_model = model.fit()

    # Forecast job market indicators for two years ahead
    forecast = fitted_model.forecast(fitted_model.y, steps=years_ahead)

    # Convert forecasted values back to DataFrame
    forecast = pd.DataFrame(forecast, index=pd.date_range(df.index[-1]+1, periods=years_ahead, freq='A'),
                            columns=df.columns)

    # Print forecasted values
    print(forecast)

These incidents can erode trust, especially in overpoliced and marginalized communities. When accountability is lacking or reform lags, the potential for abuse persists.

Reform and transparency are generally agreed to be part of the solution. Enhancing training, promoting community policing, and ensuring real oversight and accountability mechanisms can help reduce harm while maintaining public safety.
